item.title: Sabin Sees Lane For Change
item.description: The day the Trump Era began, Eli Sabin discovered that working on a state legislator's campaign could offer hope for change rather than despair. Now, at the height of Trump's reign, Sabin is promoting that same hope -- this time through his own campaign. The post Sabin Sees Lane For Change appeared first on New Haven Independent.
